{
  "root_cause": "Escape key hides the dropdown menu but does not return focus to the toggle button, causing the focus assertion to fail.",
  "repair_strategy": "Modify the dataApiKeydownHandler in dropdown.js to focus the toggle button after hiding the menu when Escape is pressed.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "js/src/dropdown.js",
      "sha256": "fc69a61b69ae1fa2c2bb923fdc393dd2742925e8af996376df5f98e38f8d810e",
      "before": "    const instance = Dropdown.getOrCreateInstance(getToggleButton)\n\n    if (isEscapeEvent) {\n      instance.hide()\n      return\n    }\n\n    if (isUpOrDownEvent) {",
      "after": "    const instance = Dropdown.getOrCreateInstance(getToggleButton)\n\n    if (isEscapeEvent) {\n      instance.hide()\n      getToggleButton.focus()\n      return\n    }\n\n    if (isUpOrDownEvent) {"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Pressing Escape will close the menu (aria-expanded false) and move focus back to the actions toggle button, satisfying the focus assertion.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "If hide() is called elsewhere (e.g., programmatically) focus will now shift to the toggle, which may be unexpected. However, the only current invocation of instance.hide() is from the Escape keydown handler.",
    "Ensure that the added focus() call does not interfere with screen readers or cause unintended scroll."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Verify that after Escape, aria-expanded on #actions-toggle is false and focus is on #actions-toggle.",
    "Verify that ArrowDown still opens the menu and focuses the first item (#action-send).",
    "Verify that Enter on a menu item selects the action and updates #last-action.",
    "Verify that clicking outside the menu closes it and returns focus to the toggle (existing behavior).",
    "Verify that the menu can still be opened and navigated with keyboard after the change."
  ]
}
